subject: general
question: ______ was a blind poet who sang the glory of Krishna in his collection by the name 'Sursagar'.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Surdas__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sursagar is a poetic composition by Surdas.**
 
• **Surdas was a great devotee of Lord Krishna.**
 
• In Sursagar, **most of the compositions are attributed to Lord Krishna.**
 
• He was one of the **prominent figures in the Bhakti Movement **between the 14th to 17th centuries of India.
 
• He was **blind and was a poet.**
 
• **Other literary works** of Surdas are **Sur Saravali, and Sahitya Lahari.**
 
• His most of poems were written praising Lord Krishna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virdas**

 
 
• He is an** Indian comedian, actor, and musician.**
 
• Also, a** bollywood** actor worked in films like **Badmaash Company, Delhi Belly, and Go Goa Gone.**
 
 
 
• **Chaitanya​**
 
 
• **Born at Navadwip, West Bengal, **in 1486 A.D.
 
• **He was famous for his unique devotion to Krishna with ecstatic song and dance.**
 
• Chaitanya introduced the **Sankhya philosophy of “Achintya bhedabheda”.**
 
 
 
• **Vidyapati**
 
 
• Vidyapati Thakur was a **Maithili Brahman writer and poet.**
 
• He was known for his** Sanskrit works and also for his erotic poetry** written in the **Maithili language.**
 
• He was a **devotee of Shiva, but also wrote love songs and devotional Vaishnava songs.**
